Rule R-AE-COLLECTION-01: collect a synthetic adverse event candidate when an event term is reported.
Trigger: present ae_term
Branch CAND: WHEN present ae_term THEN verify the original record, event term, first occurrence
Follow-up: record the source and unresolved facts
Completion: source-backed event information is reviewed
Required facts: ae_term

Rule R-AE-GRADE-01: apply the synthetic project toxicity grade criterion separately.
Trigger: grade_criteria_met = true
Branch G3: WHEN grade_criteria_met = true THEN verify the investigator grade against the adopted criteria
Follow-up: record the adopted grade scale version
Completion: investigator grade and rationale are documented
Required facts: grade_criteria_met

Rule R-AE-SERIOUSNESS-01: assess synthetic SAE seriousness criteria separately from toxicity grade.
Trigger: sae_criteria_met = true
Branch SAE: WHEN sae_criteria_met = true THEN verify every serious criterion; confirm the reporting obligation
Follow-up: record the serious criterion and reporting basis
Completion: serious determination and reporting are reviewed by the responsible person
Required facts: sae_criteria_met

Rule R-AE-RELATEDNESS-01: require a separate synthetic investigator relatedness assessment.
Trigger: present relatedness_assessment
Branch REL: WHEN present relatedness_assessment THEN review the investigator relatedness; review the rationale
Follow-up: retain the medical conclusion separately
Completion: relatedness assessment and rationale are documented
Required facts: relatedness_assessment

Rule R-AE-EXPECTEDNESS-01: use the project-adopted reference safety information for expectedness.
Trigger: present ib_version
Branch EXP: WHEN present ib_version THEN compare the event term with the adopted reference safety information
Follow-up: confirm the version applicable at event time
Completion: expectedness and adopted version are documented
Required facts: ib_version, expectedness_assessment

Rule R-AESI-01: check a synthetic AESI list separately.
Trigger: present aesi_list
Branch AESI: WHEN present aesi_list THEN check the event term against the applicable AESI list
Follow-up: record list version and source
Completion: AESI list review is documented
Required facts: aesi_list, ae_term

Rule R-DLT-01: review a synthetic DLT criterion and assessment window.
Trigger: present dlt_criteria
Branch DLT: WHEN present dlt_criteria THEN check DLT criteria; check the applicable assessment window
Follow-up: record treatment cycle and window
Completion: DLT criteria, window and responsible review are documented
Required facts: dlt_criteria, dlt_window

Rule R-PD-01: review a synthetic protocol deviation candidate.
Trigger: protocol_deviation_suspected = true
Branch PD: WHEN protocol_deviation_suspected = true THEN verify PD criteria, reporting, correction
Follow-up: keep reporting and correction as separate actions
Completion: PD determination and independent actions are reviewed
Required facts: protocol_deviation_suspected

Rule R-SAE-TIMELINESS-01: keep synthetic safety event and reporting time anchors separate.
Trigger: sae_criteria_met = true
Branch TIME: WHEN sae_criteria_met = true THEN verify event date, awareness time, entry time, actual reporting time, project timeline
Follow-up: do not infer a deadline when the awareness time or project timeline is absent
Completion: time anchors and applicable reporting rule are documented
Required facts: sae_criteria_met, safety_awareness_date, safety_reported_date
